description: Architecture Decision Records — logged by Chief Agent

decisions.title: Replace Apify with Reddit OAuth API
decisions.context: Apify free tier ($5/account) runs out in ~3 days with 18 posts/day. Reddit .json endpoint is dead (403). PullPush.io data is frozen.
decisions.decision: Keep Apify for now with multi-key fallback (3 accounts = $30 = ~81 days). Reddit OAuth API researched and verified working (free, 60 req/min). Migration planned for future.
decisions.consequences: Must create new Apify accounts every ~3 months. Reddit OAuth API ready when needed.

decisions.title: Post/Save ordering — Supabase first, then Buffer
decisions.context: Original code posted to Buffer first, then saved to Supabase. If Supabase save failed, the tweet was live on X but untracked — causing duplicate posts on next run.
decisions.decision: Reverse ordering: Save to Supabase (status: 'posting') first, then post to Buffer, then update status to 'published'/'failed'.
decisions.consequences: Eliminates orphaned posts. Status 'posting' posts that fail Buffer can be detected and retried.

decisions.title: Multi-key fallback for all external APIs
decisions.context: Single API keys are single points of failure. Apify quota exhaustion, MiMo rate limits, or Buffer 429s would halt the pipeline.
decisions.decision: Implement KeyManager class with auto-rotation on 429/quota errors. Apply to both Apify and MiMo. Up to 3 keys per API.
decisions.consequences: Requires managing multiple accounts. Key status tracked and reported in Slack.

decisions.title: Slack notifications for every pipeline run
decisions.context: Pipeline failures were silent — only visible in GitHub Actions logs. No way to know if posts were going out without manually checking.
decisions.decision: Add Slack Block Kit notifications after every run: success (with tweet, image, subreddit, upvotes), failure (with error details), no-posts (with subreddits scanned).
decisions.consequences: Requires Slack workspace + bot token. Adds ~2s per pipeline run.

decisions.title: Image required for all posts
decisions.context: Text-only posts on X get significantly lower engagement. User confirmed image is required, not optional.
decisions.decision: Filter scraped posts to only those with image URLs. Posts without images are skipped even if they have the highest upvotes.
decisions.consequences: Some high-upvote text posts are missed. Reduces total qualifying posts per scrape.

decisions.title: MiMo prompt includes current date and latest model names
decisions.context: MiMo generated outdated model references (GPT-4o instead of GPT-5.6 Sol) because its training data has a cutoff date.
decisions.decision: Inject current date and latest model names (GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Opus 5, Gemini 3.6 Flash, Llama 4, Mistral Large 3) into every MiMo prompt.
decisions.consequences: Must update model names periodically as new versions release. MiMo output quality improved significantly.
